items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Not too much. They were very busy people, especially in those days. Mostly it was Chubby Goldfarb, the manager.

ctx.x: How much contact did you have with him?
Not too much. They were very busy people, especially in those days. Mostly it was Chubby Goldfarb, the manager. Do you remember what the article said?

I'm trying to remember. It was something--some negative things that were said between you and Woody's manager, but I can't remember exactly what it was. Perhaps something about not being paid for certain arrangements or something like that. I can't remember what.
